title: AGENTS.md
summary: Định dạng hướng dẫn ở cấp repository cho coding agent: cung cấp context, quy tắc phát triển, kiểm thử và quy trình đóng góp một cách rõ ràng, nhất quán.

sections.heading: AGENTS.md là gì?
body: AGENTS.md là một định dạng mở ở cấp repository để hướng dẫn coding agent. Dự án zskbot/agents.md mô tả nó như một nơi nhất quán để cung cấp context và instruction giúp AI coding agent làm việc trên dự án.

Treat AGENTS.md as operational project context, not as application code. It should tell an agent how the repository is structured, which commands are expected, what validation is required, and which local conventions matter.
The supplied project also includes the agents.md website, which explains the format and examples.

sections.heading: Phạm vi và thứ tự ưu tiên
body: A root AGENTS.md can establish repository-wide rules. Deeper AGENTS.md files can provide narrower instructions for a subdirectory. Agents should resolve the most specific applicable instruction set while respecting higher-priority system, platform, and user instructions.
For Velclaw, use this hierarchy to keep global engineering rules short and place package-specific build, testing, or deployment rules close to the code they govern.

examples.code:
Repository root
└─ AGENTS.md              ← global project rules
   ├─ packages/
   │  └─ AGENTS.md        ← package-specific rules
   └─ apps/
      └─ AGENTS.md        ← app-specific rules

sections.heading: Nội dung nên có trong AGENTS.md
body: Keep instructions concrete and executable. A useful file normally tells agents how to enter the project, install dependencies, run development servers, run tests and linting, build packages, and prepare pull requests.
Document repository-specific conventions such as package-manager choice, monorepo commands, required checks, source-of-truth files, generated files, and restrictions on destructive operations.

Avoid turning AGENTS.md into a giant copy of every project document. Link to the canonical documentation for details and keep the agent file focused on information that materially changes how work should be performed.
bullets: Repository structure and important source-of-truth files

sections.heading: Mẫu đề xuất cho Velclaw
body: Với các repository của Velclaw, kết hợp AGENTS.md với Docus, skills và CI workflows hiện có. AGENTS.md should define the minimum execution contract; Docus should contain the detailed architecture and operational reference.

A good Velclaw AGENTS.md should state the required validation gates before a change is considered complete, identify generated documentation as build output, and point agents toward the relevant skill or package documentation instead of duplicating it.
For agent-heavy repositories, keep the root file concise and add nested files only where the subtree genuinely has different build or safety requirements.

examples.code:
# Velclaw Agent Guide

## Development
- Use the repository package manager and existing scripts.
- Prefer the development server during interactive work.

## Validation
- Run type-check, lint, and targeted tests for changed code.
- Run the production build when the delivery workflow requires it.

## Documentation
- Keep generated API docs generated by TypeDoc.
- Keep conceptual docs in Docus.

sections.heading: Quy trình thực thi của agent
body: AGENTS.md works best as a compact execution contract: orient in the repository, identify the source of truth, plan the smallest coherent change, implement it, run the required gates, and record blockers rather than claiming completion without evidence.
This complements Velclaw's existing agent workflow of Understand → Plan → Review → Apply → Build → Fix. The AGENTS.md layer supplies repository-specific constraints to that workflow.
bullets: Orient: inspect the relevant source and instructions.
Plan: define the smallest change and acceptance checks.
Implement: modify only the required scope.
Validate: run deterministic tests, lint, and type checks.
Report: preserve actual evidence and identify unresolved blockers.

sections.heading: Tích hợp với Docus và TypeDoc
body: Kiến trúc docs Velclaw xem AGENTS.md, Docus và TypeDoc là các lớp bổ sung cho nhau.

AGENTS.md defines how an AI coding agent should operate inside a repository. Docus explains the platform, architecture, deployment, and operational concepts. TypeDoc generates API reference directly from TypeScript source.
This separation keeps agent instructions actionable while keeping long-form documentation and generated API reference maintainable.

examples.code:
Velclaw documentation stack
├─ AGENTS.md  → agent operating contract
├─ Docus      → guides / architecture / operations
├─ TypeDoc    → TypeScript API reference
└─ Git        → source of truth
